The learned Counsel appearing for the Petitioner has stated that he will be filing an application before Respondent No.2 (the Collector) for referring the dispute as to apportionment to the Authority as contemplated under Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He, accordingly, sought leave to withdraw the above Writ Petition.

In these circumstances, the above Writ Petition is disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to the Petitioner to file an application before Respondent No.2 for referring the dispute as to apportionment within a period of two weeks from today.

If such an application is filed, any compensation that is payable by the State in relation to the acquisition which forms the subject matter of the above Petition, shall be deposited with the said Authority.

It is needless to state that the application proposed to be filed by the Petitioner before Respondent No.2, shall be decided on its own merit and in accordance with law.
3. This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.

[ M.M.
